name: food-order-insights
description: Analyze Türkiye food-delivery receipts, lifestyle patterns, and explainable risk signals through connected Gmail tools.

interface.shortDescription: Understand food orders from Gmail receipts.

defaultPrompt: Analyze my food-delivery orders from the last year.
Show my delivery spending and ordering patterns.
Run my Food Order Risk Report and suggest lifestyle changes.
Export my analyzed food-order data to Excel.
